note_en: The pattern 只有……才…… means "only if… (then)…": “仁”只有在和别人相处时才有意义 "ren only has meaning when you're with other people." Note that 才 goes right before the verb in the second half; English puts "only" up front, but Chinese needs both words to frame the condition.
